description: ADSR envelope generator with a delay stage and a self-gating hold mode, and a CV input for every knob

params.text: The pause at zero before the attack begins, up to 10 seconds
How long the envelope takes to rise from zero to full, up to 10 seconds
How long it takes to fall from full to the sustain level, up to 10 seconds
The level the envelope holds between the decay and the release, as a percentage of full
How long it takes to fall from the sustain level back to zero, up to 10 seconds
How long the internal gate lasts in TRIG mode, up to 10 seconds
Logarithmic, linear or exponential rise through the attack stage
Exponential, linear or logarithmic fall through the decay stage
Exponential, linear or logarithmic fall through the release stage
Starts the envelope by hand, and starts every polyphonic channel at once
GATE runs the envelope from a gate at the trigger input for as long as it is high; TRIG starts a cycle from a trigger and gates it internally for the time set by HOLD
In TRIG mode, LOOP restarts the cycle as each release stage finishes and STOP ends it at zero
Multiplies every stage time by ten
ATT attacks from the envelope's current value when a new trigger comes in; RST restarts the whole cycle from the delay stage

inputs.text: 0-10V scaling the delay time, which reaches the knob's setting at 10V and zero at 0V
0-10V scaling the attack time, which reaches the knob's setting at 10V and zero at 0V
0-10V scaling the decay time, which reaches the knob's setting at 10V and zero at 0V
0-10V scaling the sustain level, which reaches the knob's setting at 10V and zero at 0V
0-10V scaling the release time, which reaches the knob's setting at 10V and zero at 0V
0-10V scaling the hold time, which reaches the knob's setting at 10V and zero at 0V
A gate here runs the envelope in GATE mode and a trigger starts a cycle in TRIG mode; the channels patched here set the polyphony

outputs.text: 5V for as long as the envelope is in its delay stage
5V for as long as the envelope is in its attack stage
5V for as long as the envelope is in its decay stage
5V for as long as the envelope is at the sustain level
5V for as long as the envelope is in its release stage
The envelope subtracted from 10V, so it falls as the envelope rises
A 5V trigger each time a release stage finishes

menu: Resume loop on load — an envelope that was looping when the patch was saved starts looping again when the patch is loaded
